caption:
👶 Where children still don't survive — 1900 → 2024.

In 1950 one child in four died before turning five. Today it's one in twenty-seven. Watch the ranking change continents: in 1900 it's led by Russia, Austria and Germany, above 37%; in 2024 by Nigeria and Niger, around 11%. Read the start carefully: in 1900 only 25 countries counted their dead, almost all of them in Europe.

📊 Data: UN IGME and Gapminder, via Our World in Data (CC BY 4.0). 25 countries reported in 1900, 212 today; years between surveys are interpolated.
